select sat.audit_flag , sat.menu_cd , sm.menu_nm , sat.audit_trail_contents , sat.insert_datetime, sat.insert_user_id, su.user_nm as insert_user_nm from sys_audit_trail sat left join sys_menu sm on sm.menu_cd = sat.menu_cd left join sys_user su on su.user_id = sat.insert_user_id where 1=1
and ( sm.menu_nm like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or sat.audit_trail_contents like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
and sat.audit_flag = 'I'
and sat.audit_flag = 'U'
and sat.audit_flag = 'D'
and sat.insert_datetime between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by sat.insert_datetime desc
